metadata.title: Palantir Stock Slumps Ahead of Q2 Earnings

content.text:
This article first appeared on GuruFocus.
Palantir Technologies (NASDAQ:PLTR) shares declined 5% on Tuesday as investors locked in gains after the stock's recent advance and shifted attention toward the company's upcoming second-quarter earnings report.
The stock followed a roughly 7% jump in the previous session, prompting some traders to reduce positions after the recent move higher. Investors are now watching Palantir's upcoming results for updates on revenue growth, artificial intelligence demand, and business expansion.
Palantir has remained one of the market's closely followed AI-focused companies, but its valuation has also drawn scrutiny as investors assess whether future growth can support current expectations. Concerns about elevated valuations have affected several software and AI-related stocks in recent months.
The company is scheduled to report second-quarter results on Aug. 3, with investors expected to focus on commercial growth, government contracts, and adoption of its artificial intelligence platforms.
Shares of Palantir moved lower alongside broader weakness in technology stocks on Tuesday, as markets also reacted to concerns around AI spending, semiconductor demand, and upcoming major earnings reports.
